text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — BrightHealth requested eval-triggered alerts + an Optimize advisor that recommends batching/caching/quant defaults. Target pilot July.
Samir Khan: sounds like two workstreams: alerts (signal + webhook) and advisor (heuristics + UI). do we have capacity?
Jen Lee: split ownership. alerts = eval hooks + rules + integrations. advisor = telemetry, scoring, UX.
Ravi Kumar: tech notes: alerts need per-prompt eval hooks, a lightweight rules engine (thresholds, windowing), and robust webhook retries. advisor needs aggregated telemetry and a small scoring service to rank recs.
Alex Gomez: field ask — low false positives and explainability. BrightHealth would pilot if FP <5% and recs have clear rationale.
Maya Patel: proposed gate: alerts validated on a 5k prompt set with FP <= 5%, webhook + retry/backoff, ops runbook. advisor must produce 3 ranked actions (batch size, kv TTL, quant profile) with simulated >=10% cost reduction on most workloads.
Samir Khan: rough effort: alerts infra ~3 sprints; advisor backend + heuristics + minimal UI ~3-4 sprints. shared telemetry and flags.
Jen Lee: prioritize alerts MVP first (simple threshold + webhook + per-tenant enable). get customer feedback before full advisor work.
Ravi Kumar: heuristic pseudocode: `if duplicate_rate > 0.2 and p99_latency < 150ms: recommend_kv_ttl = min(600, duplicate_window_secs) else: recommend_kv_ttl = 0` Quant gating: run 100-shot eval; if quality_drop <0.8% and latency_gain>15% recommend int8.
Maya Patel: action items — Samir: draft acceptance matrix by Wed EOD; Jen: sketch alert UX + payload by Fri; Ravi: prototype heuristics by Tue. I'll coordinate legal/support and raise GPU budget.
ProductBot: :robot_face: pilot created "BrightHealth Optimize Pilot" assigned to maya.patel, samir.khan; target start 2026-07-01.
Alex Gomez: i'll confirm labeled eval set timeline and pilot contacts with BrightHealth.
Maya Patel: thanks. i'll schedule a 20min kickoff next week.
